paragraphs.text:
The  wolverine  squeals  as  your  bullet  rips  through  its  side. 
Missing Bernard by inches, the beast lands hard and squirms 
in the litter of brown pine needles. You draw the student away. 
Has this near-tragedy made you rethink your strategy?
To head back to civilization, go to 232. To push ahead, go to 604.
